eligibility.rule: At least 200 frozen eligible throws and ten eligible games in each season independently; team changes pool by raw GSIS ID.
eligibility.population: Recorded passers, not position-certified; frozen 560 actor-seasons; no adjacent-season requirement.
eligibility.model_limit: Generating CP/EP model and training vintage unknown; observed seasonal values are not era-neutral skill or forecasts.
eligibility.missing_player_season: No eligible record; do not substitute another year/player or a zero.

denominators.scramble_contribution: Sum supplied signed raw EPA on recorded scramble S divided by N_O. O=D disjoint union R. S subset D. R is recorded non-scramble actor-running, including aborted/lateral plays; no CP, E-game, positive-EPA or penalty filter.
denominators.D: AD-1.1: qb_dropback1, recorded pass/run, spike0,kneel0,two_point0; raw passer for pass/sack, raw rusher for scramble run. Binary pass/sack scramble flags are diagnostics, never reclassification.
denominators.R: Recorded run, rush_attempt1, scramble0,kneel0,two_point0; raw rusher; no absent-passer or designed-run requirement.

uncertainty.interval: Approximate marginal 95% conditional all-O-game deletion sensitivity: theta +/-1.96*sqrt((G-1)/G*sum((deletion-mean(deletion))^2)). Include all O games, including zero-S and R-only games. Positive full and deletion O denominators; fixed membership; no failed replicate drops.
uncertainty.collapsed: No observed deletion variation, not certainty.
uncertainty.limitations: Conditional working game-sampling sensitivity, not calibrated talent or prediction intervals. Independent game shocks, stable opportunities and normal approximation may fail. Excludes serial dependence, source/model error, selection and supporting-cast uncertainty; marginal ranges do not test player/year differences. EPA is shared whole-play value.

reference_population.rule: Within-year finite accepted C_S values from these frozen eligible player-seasons only. Consumer calculates descriptive same-year midrank percentiles; no ranks or percentiles estimated here. Display finite N; fewer than two peers unavailable. Never substitute legacy20, selected opponent, another year or zero.

missingness.zero: Zero recorded S with positive observed O yields genuine zero contribution; it does not imply zero mobility talent.
missingness.blocked: 00-0022164 season2007 withheld pending recorded-role review; all counts retained and native point/range null. No raw source repair or exclusion.
missingness.source_blocked_2011: No invented rows; see season catalog.
missingness.missing_player_season: No eligible record; do not substitute another player/year or zero.

sources.schedule_side_comparison_aliases: STL=LA; SD=LAC; OAK=LV; JAC=JAX. Comparison only; raw values unchanged.
sources.canonical_key_hash_encoding: Bytewise-sorted UTF-8 season|game_id|integer play_id|actor_id|role|population lines, newline terminated.
